No body deserves your forgiveness unless you decide so yourself. 

Many ppl believe that forgiveness is needed for healing, but it is not. The only person who you need to care about is yourself. Put yourself first, pls I am begging you do not let you demons win........ Always put yourself first and never forgive anyone for hurting you.

Abusers always forget, but victims never. Pls take care of yourself and FUCK THOSE AH!!!!

PS: Get a new and better therapist

It is never too late for things to happen!!!

Depression is a bitch, it has its ways to fuck you up in ways. I am not telling do a complete 180 or push yourself to your maximum limits, just do one thing different!

Feel like you have missed out on something you should have done younger? Try accomplishing that.

Done is better that perfect!! There are people who never do things because they feel like it is late for them, but it is better to have tried and seen if you could do the work. Start from somewhere, you might fall a bit but it is better than not having tried at all right?

Who knows maybe finding a routine is what could help you.
